entries.title: Psalms 40:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Of David. A Psalm.>> I waited patiently for Jehovah; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

entries.title: Psalms 40:2
segments: And he brought me up out of the pit of destruction, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock; he hath established my goings:

entries.title: Psalms 40:3
segments: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, praise unto our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall confide in Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 40:4
segments: Blessed is the man that hath made Jehovah his confidence, and turneth not to the proud, and to such as turn aside to lies.

entries.title: Psalms 40:5
segments: Thou, O Jehovah my God, hast multiplied thy marvellous works, and thy thoughts toward us: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee; would I declare and speak [them], they are more than can be numbered.

entries.title: Psalms 40:6
segments: ¶Sacrifice and oblation thou didst not desire: ears hast thou prepared me. Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not demanded;

entries.title: Psalms 40:7
segments: Then said I, Behold, I come, in the volume of the book it is written of me--

entries.title: Psalms 40:8
segments: To do thy good pleasure, my God, is my delight, and thy law is within my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 40:9
segments: I have published righteousness in the great congregation: behold, I have not withheld my lips, Jehovah, *thou* knowest.

entries.title: Psalms 40:10
segments: I have not hidden thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy loving-kindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

entries.title: Psalms 40:11
segments: ¶Withhold not thou, Jehovah, thy tender mercies from me; let thy loving-kindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

entries.title: Psalms 40:12
segments: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head: and my heart hath failed me.

entries.title: Psalms 40:13
segments: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me; Jehovah, make haste to my help.

entries.title: Psalms 40:14
segments: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be turned backward and confounded that take pleasure in mine adversity;

entries.title: Psalms 40:15
segments: Let them be desolate, because of their shame, that say unto me, Aha! Aha!

entries.title: Psalms 40:16
segments: Let all those that seek thee be glad and rejoice in thee; let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified!

entries.title: Psalms 40:17
segments: But I am afflicted and needy: the Lord thinketh upon me. Thou art my help and my deliverer: my God, make no delay.
